title: 4.0.0.0-dev Dexcom CGM granting permission
symptom: A popup appears asking to grant permission for reading CGM. Clicking 'Grant' appears to do nothing, but functionality is fully given (CGM values received and closed looping successful). The popup opens regularly and is annoying.
fix: The thread does not provide a definitive fix. A maintainer suggests granting permission from Android settings (Apps - AAPS - Permissions), but the user reports all permissions are already allowed. The user considers deinstalling and reinstalling AAPS.
evidence_quote: It looks like BOYDA is not installed
